answers.reason: The senate deals with central university strategy rather than faculty-level student matters, and members only sit in one body.
Budget allocation is an administrative matter outside the scope of faculty student representation.
Selecting professors is separate from student representation, and each member participates in only one body.
Although elected at the faculty level, the student representative's specific domain of student study matters belongs to the study commission, and members only take part in one body.
As the elected voice for faculty students, this representative's single place to participate is the body that prepares degree programme changes and advises on teaching.
Examination administration is handled separately from general student representation, and members only sit in one body.
Research funding is unrelated to student representation.
Rewriting module descriptions is a specific operational task, whereas the student representative participates only in their single main body.
Equipment procurement has no bearing on student representation matters.
Planning the orientation week is a practical task for regular students rather than the single formal body for the elected representative.
